in_sanskrit.name: चत्रपल
in_sanskrit.meaning: holder of an umbrella or an umbrella itself
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chhatrapal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chatra' meaning 'umbrella' or 'parasol', and 'pal' meaning 'holder'. Therefore, Chhatrapal can be translated to mean 'holder of an umbrella' or 'umbrella itself'. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is often depicted carrying an umbrella, so the name Chhatrapal can also be considered a reference to Indra.

in_hindi.name: चत्रपल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Chhatrapal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chatra' meaning 'umbrella' or 'parasol', and 'pal' meaning 'holder'. Therefore, Chhatrapal can be translated to mean 'holder of an umbrella' or 'umbrella itself' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: சத்திரபால
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Chhatrapal can be translated to mean 'holder of an umbrella' or 'umbrella itself' as well. However, it is also interpreted as 'one who holds wealth' due to the similarity in pronunciation between 'pal' (holder) and 'pallam' (wealth).

in_telugu.name: చత్రపల
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Chhatrapal can be translated to mean 'holder of an umbrella' or 'umbrella itself'. It can also be interpreted as 'one who holds the umbrella' or 'one who protects'.

in_marathi.name: Chhatrapal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Forts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhatrapal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chhatra means umbrella or fort and Pal means lord. The name Chhatrapal is derived from Sanskrit and means 'Lord of Forts'. In Hindu mythology, Chhatrapal is an epithet of several gods, particularly Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu.
